_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Leg is flat inside the Anxiety band with neutral funding and two-sided stress unresolved; coil base rate demands HOLD until a named breaker prints.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on non-directional stance (analyst explicit HOLD; narrative descriptive/no counter-signal); split only on framing (cycle phase vs commodity pipes).
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC holds a ±1.5% range, fear_greed stays ~25-40, momentum near 50, score does not break ±2 off Anxiety.
next_move.invalidated_if: Fast liquidation drives fear_greed through ~20 and momentum well below 40 (step toward Denial) OR squeeze lifts fear_greed above ~45 and momentum above ~60 (step toward Complacency).
